summary: Spacious 3-Bedroom Family Home To Let – Popular Area This spacious three-bedroom property is available to let in a popular residential area, making it an ideal home for families. The property offers generous living space throughout, with three well-proportioned bedrooms and bright, comfortable interiors that create a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Outside, there is a good-sized garden, perfect for children, outdoor entertaining, or simply enjoying some fresh air. Conveniently located close to the local hospital and a range of shops and everyday amenities, this lovely family home combines space, comfort, and practicality in a highly desirable location. Early viewing is recommended.
